+-- Harden the enhanced recommendation relations made reachable by the
+-- 011 -> 012 unblock -> 013 migration chain.
+--
+-- Caller audit summary:
+-- - Browser code uses authenticated HTTP handlers and has no direct Supabase
+--   caller for these relations or functions.
+-- - The recommendation handlers use the server-side service_role client.
+-- - The learner-profile aggregation job also uses service_role.
+-- - No checked-in runtime caller uses the analytics view, the three global
+--   state tables, or any of the five functions as a direct RPC.
+--
+-- recommendation_feedback deliberately keeps its effective 011 schema and FK
+-- contract. The later CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS in 013 never replaced it.
+
+BEGIN;
+
+ALTER TABLE public.user_learning_data ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+ALTER TABLE public.user_learning_data FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+ALTER TABLE public.recommendations ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+ALTER TABLE public.recommendations FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+ALTER TABLE public.user_learning_profiles ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+ALTER TABLE public.user_learning_profiles FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+ALTER TABLE public.recommendation_feedback ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+ALTER TABLE public.recommendation_feedback FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+ALTER TABLE public.content_similarity ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+ALTER TABLE public.content_similarity FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+ALTER TABLE public.learning_objectives ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+ALTER TABLE public.learning_objectives FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+ALTER TABLE public.recommendation_cache ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+ALTER TABLE public.recommendation_cache FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+ALTER TABLE public.algorithm_performance ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+ALTER TABLE public.algorithm_performance FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+
+-- Reset every Data API role, including service_role, so the final ACL is
+-- explicit and cannot inherit a legacy blanket grant.
+REVOKE ALL PRIVILEGES ON TABLE
+  public.user_learning_data,
+  public.recommendations,
+  public.user_learning_profiles,
+  public.recommendation_feedback,
+  public.content_similarity,
+  public.learning_objectives,
+  public.recommendation_cache,
+  public.algorithm_performance
+FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
+
+-- Table-level REVOKE does not remove column grants. Sweep every live column on
+-- all eight base tables and the analytics view.
+DO $revoke_recommendation_column_privileges$
+DECLARE
+  target_relation RECORD;
+  quoted_columns TEXT;
+BEGIN
+  FOR target_relation IN
+    SELECT
+      relation_namespace.nspname AS schema_name,
+      relation_record.relname AS relation_name,
+      relation_record.oid AS relation_oid
+    FROM pg_catalog.pg_class AS relation_record
+    JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS relation_namespace
+      ON relation_namespace.oid = relation_record.relnamespace
+    WHERE relation_namespace.nspname = 'public'
+      AND relation_record.relname IN (
+        'user_learning_data',
+        'recommendations',
+        'user_learning_profiles',
+        'recommendation_feedback',
+        'content_similarity',
+        'learning_objectives',
+        'recommendation_cache',
+        'algorithm_performance',
+        'recommendation_analytics'
+      )
+  LOOP
+    SELECT pg_catalog.string_agg(
+      pg_catalog.format('%I', attribute_record.attname),
+      ', '
+      ORDER BY attribute_record.attnum
+    )
+    INTO quoted_columns
+    FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute AS attribute_record
+    WHERE attribute_record.attrelid = target_relation.relation_oid
+      AND attribute_record.attnum > 0
+      AND NOT attribute_record.attisdropped;
+
+    IF quoted_columns IS NOT NULL THEN
+      EXECUTE pg_catalog.format(
+        'REVOKE ALL PRIVILEGES (%s) ON TABLE %I.%I FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role',
+        quoted_columns,
+        target_relation.schema_name,
+        target_relation.relation_name
+      );
+    END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+END;
+$revoke_recommendation_column_privileges$;
+
+-- These relations are service-only. Remove every historical permissive policy,
+-- including policies that omitted TO and therefore applied to PUBLIC.
+DO $drop_recommendation_policies$
+DECLARE
+  policy_record RECORD;
+BEGIN
+  FOR policy_record IN
+    SELECT
+      policy_namespace.nspname AS schema_name,
+      policy_relation.relname AS relation_name,
+      policy_definition.polname AS policy_name
+    FROM pg_catalog.pg_policy AS policy_definition
+    JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS policy_relation
+      ON policy_relation.oid = policy_definition.polrelid
+    JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS policy_namespace
+      ON policy_namespace.oid = policy_relation.relnamespace
+    WHERE policy_namespace.nspname = 'public'
+      AND policy_relation.relname IN (
+        'user_learning_data',
+        'recommendations',
+        'user_learning_profiles',
+        'recommendation_feedback',
+        'content_similarity',
+        'learning_objectives',
+        'recommendation_cache',
+        'algorithm_performance'
+      )
+  LOOP
+    EXECUTE pg_catalog.format(
+      'DROP POLICY %I ON %I.%I',
+      policy_record.policy_name,
+      policy_record.schema_name,
+      policy_record.relation_name
+    );
+  END LOOP;
+END;
+$drop_recommendation_policies$;
+
+-- Keep the existing global aggregate contract, but make base-table checks use
+-- the invoking role and remove all Data API visibility.
+ALTER VIEW public.recommendation_analytics
+  SET (security_invoker = true);
+REVOKE ALL PRIVILEGES ON TABLE public.recommendation_analytics
+FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
+
+-- Exact service_role inventory proven by checked-in runtime callers.
+GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLE public.recommendations
+TO service_role;
+GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLE public.recommendation_cache
+TO service_role;
+GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLE public.user_learning_data
+TO service_role;
+GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ON TABLE public.user_learning_profiles
+TO service_role;
+GRANT SELECT, INSERT ON TABLE public.recommendation_feedback
+TO service_role;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_cache_hit_count()
+RETURNS TRIGGER
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY INVOKER
+SET search_path = ''
+AS $function$
+BEGIN
+  NEW.hit_count = OLD.hit_count + 1;
+  NEW.last_accessed = pg_catalog.now();
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cleanup_expired_recommendations()
+RETURNS INTEGER
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY INVOKER
+SET search_path = ''
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  deleted_count INTEGER;
+BEGIN
+  DELETE FROM public.recommendations
+  WHERE expires_at < pg_catalog.now()
+    AND expires_at IS NOT NULL;
+
+  GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_count = ROW_COUNT;
+  RETURN deleted_count;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cleanup_expired_cache()
+RETURNS INTEGER
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY INVOKER
+SET search_path = ''
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+  deleted_count INTEGER;
+BEGIN
+  DELETE FROM public.recommendation_cache
+  WHERE expires_at < pg_catalog.now();
+
+  GET DIAGNOSTICS deleted_count = ROW_COUNT;
+  RETURN deleted_count;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_learning_profile_from_activity()
+RETURNS TRIGGER
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY INVOKER
+SET search_path = ''
+AS $function$
+BEGIN
+  INSERT INTO public.user_learning_profiles (
+    user_id,
+    subject_code,
+    last_activity_date,
+    total_study_time
+  )
+  VALUES (
+    NEW.user_id,
+    NEW.subject_code,
+    CURRENT_DATE,
+    COALESCE(NEW.time_spent, 0) / 60
+  )
+  ON CONFLICT (user_id, subject_code)
+  DO UPDATE SET
+    last_activity_date = CURRENT_DATE,
+    total_study_time = public.user_learning_profiles.total_study_time
body:
![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

In the `ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE` clause, referencing the existing row's column with a schema-qualified table name (`public.user_learning_profiles.total_study_time`) can cause syntax errors in some PostgreSQL versions. It is safer and more standard to qualify the column using only the table name (`user_learning_profiles.total_study_time`).

```sql
total_study_time = user_learning_profiles.total_study_time
```
